name: Knights of the Silver Hand
summary: Across Stormwind, Ironforge, and the Plaguelands, the Knights of the Silver Hand still keep their vows. Founded after the First War, the order joined martial skill with the healing and smiting power of the Holy Light. Its northern chapter fell with Lordaeron, but knights still serve in the south and fight the undead in the north.

sections.title: Creation of the Paladins
sections.body:
After Stormwind fell in the First War, Archbishop Alonsus Faol saw that the Alliance needed holy warriors fit for battle. The clerics of Northshire could heal, but lacked the martial training to hold the front lines.

So Faol and his foremost student, Uther the Lightbringer, founded the Knights of the Silver Hand, training holy warriors to endure the Second War. They joined battle-hardened knights ready to learn devotion to the Light with devout clerics willing to wear plate armor and wield warhammers.

sections.title: Glory in the Second War
sections.body:
Under Uther the Lightbringer, the first paladins became vital to the Alliance of Lordaeron. They rode into battle, lifted the spirits of weary soldiers, and faced the Horde's death knights and their sinister necromancy.

During the war, the Silver Hand put down peasant rebellions, reclaimed Caer Darrow, and helped defend Capital City from the orc siege. In the peace that followed, paladins guarded Lordaeron's borders, settled civil disputes, and upheld honor, humility, and justice.

sections.title: The Fall and Fractured Remnants
sections.body:
The Third War fractured the order. Outside Stratholme, Prince Arthas Menethil, a decorated Silver Hand knight, clashed with his mentor Uther. Uther refused to butcher the infected citizens, so Arthas unlawfully suspended the paladins. Later, Arthas fell to corruption and led the Scourge against Lordaeron. Uther was slain, and the order lost its central leadership.

The surviving northern knights split over doctrine, giving rise to the zealous Scarlet Crusade and the vigilant Argent Dawn. In Stormwind and Ironforge, surviving chapters still train paladins under the Silver Hand's banner.

faq.q: Who founded the Knights of the Silver Hand?
faq.answer: Archbishop Alonsus Faol founded the Knights of the Silver Hand after the First War and chose Uther the Lightbringer as its first knight.

faq.q: Does the Silver Hand still exist?
faq.answer: Yes. Though the Scourge's destruction of Lordaeron shattered its northern high command, active chapters still serve the Alliance from Stormwind's Cathedral of Light and Ironforge's halls.

faq.q: How are the Scarlet Crusade and Argent Dawn related to the Silver Hand?
aliases: how did the silver hand split
faq.answer: After Uther and Highlord Alexandros Mograine died, the surviving paladins in Lordaeron split over their beliefs. Hardline fanatics formed the Scarlet Crusade to eliminate outsiders, while more moderate veterans founded the Argent Dawn.

faq.q: Can non-humans join the Knights of the Silver Hand?
aliases: who can be a silver hand paladin
faq.answer: Yes. The order began with human knights and clerics from Lordaeron, then welcomed dwarven priests and warriors of Ironforge during and after the Second War. They bore the Silver Hand's insignia and followed its rites.

angles.text: As a human or dwarf serving the Alliance, your paladin's oaths, librams, and martial ways trace back to the laws laid down by Archbishop Faol and Uther the Lightbringer.
As a priest, your calling helped shape the Silver Hand. The order arose because the priesthood was vulnerable in the First War, joining divine ministry with heavy warfare.
As a member of the Alliance, you inherit the Silver Hand's ideals. They inspired soldiers across every human realm to stand firm against darkness.
As a human, you can honor the Silver Hand as the height of virtue, honor, and courage. Its great northern masters have fallen, but Stormwind keeps their memory alive.
